steps.title: Setup App Identity
steps.description: Configure the core application metadata including dynamic package configuration and dynamic application name setting in metadata descriptors.

steps.title: Define Cloud Data Schema
steps.description: Define schema descriptors for local and cloud workout metrics, total activity computations, and dynamic authentication rules.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build System
steps.description: Define targets, compilation parameters, standard SDK configuration, and Android build environment specs.

steps.title: Construct Manifest Specifications
steps.description: Declare permissions, core entry point structures, launcher attributes, and design parameters inside the App Manifest.

steps.title: Implement API Client Engine
steps.description: Build high-performance native HTTP client handler using standard Java HttpURLConnection supporting dynamic App ID binding, authentication tokens, and CRUD operations.

steps.title: Develop Dynamic Authentication Handlers
steps.description: Establish login routing, registration processing, local token caching, and secure session maintenance with strict password verification.

steps.title: Build OTP Password Recovery Engine
steps.description: Formulate logic for requesting security OTP verification via email and processing backend token resets for account restoration.

steps.title: Program Local Calculation Algorithms
steps.description: Implement off-line calculations for workout duration aggregates, cumulative calories, and Body Mass Index (BMI) computations on device hardware.

steps.title: Assemble Core Navigation Controller
steps.description: Program transition sequences, view management states, dialog interactions, list updates, and real-time computation displays.

steps.title: Generate User Interface Layout
steps.description: Craft a clean layout interface using XML components, featuring dual auth-main toggles, inputs, metrics grids, dynamic scroll cards, and interactive buttons.

steps.title: Building FitPulse
steps.description: Compile sources, generate standard bytecode assets, sign standard test package, and assemble the final executable archive.
